notes.title: Patch 1.0.4: Great news, everyone!
notes.notes:
We've been very busy these last couple days working away to bring you some updates! The result? A new Patch is now available. The game still has some polishing to do but, hopefully this patch allows you to have a better understanding and certainly, a much more fun, experience in the meantime!

-Token Tracker has been added! Now you can keep count of the amount of tokens collected per each level. 
- Bug (the one that melted your video card from cuteness) has been fixed!  (Limited FPS to 60).
-Updated some Menu Ui elements to make them look cleaner. (Even droplets need to take a bath from time to time).
-Time Attack Scoreboard should now be visible the first 5 times before a record is entered.


As always, thank you for your constant feedback and support! We couldn't be happier with our journey thus far. You guys are amazing. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi! We've been taking note of your feedback, and we're bringing you the first update of the game, with a lot of fixes. Hopefully this solves most of the issues some players are having. We are already working on a new update! It will complete the game a little more, and we are planning to release it before the end of this year!

[list]
[*]Fixed the “texture bug” in the levels “Ice to meet you” and “Drop Alive”.
[*]Now the third token (aka shy token) of “Sparkway to Heaven” can be achieved!
[*]Fixed some collisions in “High Voltage”.
[*]Oops! now there is another water leak in the level “Warming up!”.
[*]The last firepipe of the level “too hot for my drop” has been fixed!
[*]Fixed collisions and hitboxes of the moving spikes in the level “Drop Alive”.
[*]Normal Water leaks now stay on the ground, Dirt water doesn't stay in the floor anymore.
[*]Drop doesn’t celebrate anymore before actually finishing the level. You silly excited Drop. Also, Drop overcame the trauma of facing the outside world in the roof and now celebrates in “Like a Drop in a Storm”.
[*]All forms of electricity don’t pierce your ear with the force of a thousand suns anymore.
[*]Elevator in “Sparkway to Heaven” doesn’t sound anymore if you pause.
[/list]

notes.title: Drop Alive team reporting for duty
notes.notes:
We want you to know that we received a lot of feedback about improvements and bugs from all of you, and we are working with the team to fix them. We are also working to implement the game's intro and ending cutscenes in the next few days.

[strike]Some of the players who bought the Deluxe Edition informed us that the extra content isn't downloading. We already know where the issue is and we are working to get it fixed within the next few days. Those who purchase the Deluxe Edition and encounter this issue please don't worry, you'll get the content as soon as the update is available. [/strike] FIXED!

Last but not least we want to share with you one of our favorite fanmade videos. There are already dozens of let's plays about our game, and we are thankful that Drop Alive has so many fans in such short time.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zcYiCwHiSBg

notes.title: We are live! (no pun intended)
notes.notes:
[b]We’re extremely happy to announce “Drop Alive” is now available on Steam![/b] The game is free to play; there’s no In-App purchase and no advertising either! We want everyone to have as much of an equal opportunity to play and just enjoy the experience. Also, for those willing to contribute with Drop Alive, we’ve got an exclusive [b]Deluxe Edition containing Skins, OST, Artwork and more.[/b]  

As for the Deluxe Edition, It has no new levels. It does however, contain the game’s Original Soundtrack, stunning Wallpapers and the cutest Artbook you’ll ever see with 60 pages entirely covered in original art (and cuteness). On a side note; for those who want to get the Deluxe Edition, we’ll be adding a Gold Skin within the next few days!  

[b]Lastly, we’re planning on releasing a DLC in the nearby future[/b]. This version will present more levels and exclusive material for all of you. For that reason we’d like to know what are your thoughts and opinions on it since we’re more than excited to keep on sharing Drop Alive with you all!

 
[b]Things to take into account:[/b] The game has some minor bugs we found over the last few days. We want you to know we’re already working on it so as to get rid of them due next update! Needless to say, if you stumble upon one, feel free to let us know in the comments section!
